Utilize volumetric lighting techniques to capture the intense, warm glow of the setting sun as it casts long, dancing shadows across the warriors and their mounts. The warriors themselves should be rendered with maximum attention to historical detail, wearing authentic Xiongnu armor and carrying period-correct weapons such as composite bows and curved swords. The landscape should be expansive and authentic, featuring undulating grasslands, scattered boulders, and perhaps a distant mountain range fading into the twilight haze. Set the resolution at an 8K standard to ensure the finest possible level of detail and clarity is achieved.
